name: MD Glitch
author: Lichthaus
summary: A failing portable disc recorder: a low-bitrate transform codec with up to eight re-encodes, an anti-skip buffer that stutters, drops out and jumps (Bump and Freeze keys), and a digital input with clock slips and bit errors. Live display skin. Gens 6-8 add up to 46 ms of latency, best on playback tracks.
